        if not isinstance(flag, bool):

    tracks = []

        if not parsed["ok"]:

        tracks.append(parsed["track"])
        index = index + 1
    if not allow_duplicates:
        seen = []
        position = 0
        for track in tracks:
            pair = (track["artist"].lower(), track["title"].lower())
            if pair in seen:

            seen.append(pair)
